notes: meaneth is read as the linking verb standing where the copula would stand in the verbless interrogative clause, so it joins the interrogative predicate (rule 20).

In this great shout the ASV writes one determiner for three article morphemes and a demonstrative; the demonstrative pronoun takes it and all three articles go unrepresented (rules 41 and 47), the construct qol keeping a supplied the of its own.
Both arthrous recta (ha-teru'ah, ha-ivrim) keep the the standing before their own word, so nothing is fronted (rule 29).
